title: QaCheckId
description: The closed set of technical QA checks (PRD REQ-100 / REQ-084 / REQ-104, tech-spec §15 step 7). Enumerated as a contract rather than left as free-form strings for one reason: the Phase 4 acceptance criterion is that EVERY promised check has a positive and a negative fixture, and that is only countable against a closed list. A check that exists in code but not here cannot be reported; a check listed here with no implementation fails the coverage test.
